Map dates to time steps

Source: R/time.R
time_index.Rd

Map dates to time steps

Usage

time_index(time, dates)

Arguments

time

A stareal_time with calendar steps.

dates

Dates: Date, date-times (read in their own time zone), or strings "YYYY-MM-DD".

Value

Integer step indices (1..n_steps), NA for missing or unreadable dates and for dates outside the window.

Examples

tf <- time_frame("2020-01", "2020-12")
time_index(tf, as.Date(c("2020-01-15", "2020-12-31", "2021-01-01")))
#> [1]  1 12 NA
